preconditions.description: The dimensions of tables A and B must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= n for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in table A must be within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i][j] <= n for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in table B must be within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not is_transformable else True
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to transform A into B, output -1.
If transformation is possible, output the number of sortings k, which must be between 0 and 5000.

postconditions.expression: is_transformable and all(1 <= c[i] <= m for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: If transformation is possible, output the columns c_1, ..., c_k, each within the range 1 to m.
